```yaml
name: OpenTherm v4.2 Spec Audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  audit-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install markdown

      - name: Verify ADR-044 Webhook Implementation
        run: |
          echo "Checking for ADR-044 Webhook implementation..."
          
          # Check if webhook.ino exists
          if [ ! -f "src/OTGW-firmware/webhook.ino" ]; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: webhook.ino not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for key implementation elements
          webhook_content=$(cat src/OTGW-firmware/webhook.ino)
          
          # Check for GET vs POST selection
          if ! echo "$webhook_content" | grep -q "WebhookPayload"; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: WebhookPayload not found in webhook.ino"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for local URL enforcement
          if ! echo "$webhook_content" | grep -q "isLocalUrl"; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: isLocalUrl function not found in webhook.ino"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for payload template expansion
          if ! echo "$webhook_content" | grep -q "static char\[201\]"; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: Static buffer allocation not found in webhook.ino"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for edge-only trigger
          if ! echo "$webhook_content" | grep -q "StatusFlags.*bit.*edge"; then
            echo "⚠ WARNING: Edge-only trigger pattern not clearly documented in webhook.ino"
          fi
          
          echo "✅ ADR-044 Webhook implementation verified"

      - name: Verify ADR-045 PS=1 Parsing Implementation
        run: |
          echo "Checking for ADR-045 PS=1 parsing implementation..."
          
          # Check for processPSSummary function
          if ! grep -r "processPSSummary" src/; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: processPSSummary function not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for PROGMEM lookup tables
          ps_content=$(find src/ -name "*.ino" -o -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" | xargs grep -l "PSSUMMARY_MSGIDS")
          if [ -z "$ps_content" ]; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: PS=1 lookup tables not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for comma count format detection
          if ! grep -r "comma.*count\|count.*comma" src/; then
            echo "⚠ WARNING: Format detection by comma count not clearly implemented"
          fi
          
          # Check for serial buffer extension
          if ! grep -r "512.*bytes\|buffer.*512" src/; then
            echo "⚠ WARNING: Serial buffer extension to 512 bytes not clearly implemented"
          fi
          
          echo "✅ ADR-045 PS=1 parsing implementation verified"

      - name: Verify ADR Documentation
        run: |
          echo "Checking ADR documentation..."
          
          # Check for ADR-044 documentation
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr/ADR-044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md" ]; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: ADR-044 documentation not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for ADR-045 documentation
          if [ ! -f "docs/adr/ADR-045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md" ]; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: ADR-045 documentation not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ ADR documentation verified"

      - name: Validate ADR References in Code
        run: |
          echo "Validating ADR references in codebase..."
          
          # Check that all ADRs referenced in code exist
          adrs_found=$(find src/ -name "*.ino" -o -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" | xargs grep -o "ADR-[0-9]\{3\}" 2>/dev/null | sort -u)
          
          for adr in $adrs_found; do
            if [ ! -f "docs/adr/$adr-*.md" ]; then
              echo "❌ ERROR: Reference to $adr found in code but no documentation file exists"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          
          echo "✅ All ADR references validated"

      - name: Run evaluation framework
        run: |
          echo "Running evaluation framework to check ADR compliance..."
          python evaluate.py
          
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ Evaluation framework detected issues"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Evaluation framework passed"

      - name: Final verification
        run: |
          echo "Final verification of ADR compliance..."
          
          # Verify both ADRs are properly implemented
          if [ ! -f "src/OTGW-firmware/webhook.ino" ] || [ ! -f "docs/adr/ADR-044-webhook-outbound-http-integration.md" ]; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: ADR-044 not fully implemented"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if ! grep -r "processPSSummary" src/ || [ ! -f "docs/adr/ADR-045-ps1-print-summary-parsing.md" ]; then
            echo "❌ ERROR: ADR-045 not fully implemented"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "🎉 All ADRs properly implemented and documented!"
```
